# Fixer, round 3, PR #2639 (R10-FLY-GH-READ-RETRY, PR 2 of 2), topic r10-fly-gh-read-retry-2. PR head b79c3d4f69bb603ec559ceb2f19f974c917b72f3 (branch fix/r10-fly-gh-read-retry-2)

The round-2 review blocked it: `git fetch origin probe/rev-2639-369e5c9b && git show FETCH_HEAD:verdict.md` (and its ev/, especially ev/plant.py and ev/plant.txt). Two items:

1. retry-rule-unsound. `gh_read.urllib_wait` checks `x-ratelimit-remaining == "0"` before the status (gh_read.py:106-109), so a 404, 401, 422 or permission 403 that carries a spent bucket takes the wait-and-retry arm: four calls and the 15/45 schedule, where INSTRUMENTS.md:329-331 and the body say one call. Fix it architecturally: consult the bucket only for the codes the rule names as rate-limit responses (403/429 with the rate-limit signal), and make every other 4xx refuse after its one call whatever the headers. Failing test first (fixer.md): add self-test rows for 404, 401, 422 and a permission 403, each with x-ratelimit-remaining: 0, that assert one call; show them red at this head, green after. Keep the real rate-limit arm's rows green, and show a mutant that re-orders the checks turns the new rows red.
2. pr-contract is red (check-run 120222982188): `## Red checks` does not name `nightly-status`, which was red because the first scheduled Nightly had not concluded (run 39890399205 in progress). Name it with that cause, or, if it has gone green by the time you re-take the body, say so with the run id.

Then: run every touched instrument's self-test (gh_read, merge_train, record_row, app_approve, pr_args, merge_pr), `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/entities.py` and tests/structure.py, and the scoped gate with PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1. Re-take the body completely; carry_audit must read 0 unrouted, 0 bad.

Follow dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main. Merge origin/main first. Spare the GitHub API.
